summary: Iteration 3 testing (Notifications + Admin Sidebar + Home redesign + SWR cache + debounce). Backend: 32/33 passing (1 flake = upstream data.gov.in timeout on /api/mandi/districts; not a code bug). All 11 new Notification endpoints pass (auth/list/create/broadcast-scheme/broadcast-product/delete, 404s, 401s, since filter, limit cap). Frontend: ALL critical flows pass — 4 Home feature containers render, home-refresh-btn + Last updated timestamp, NotificationBell with unread badge, dropdown open/close, admin sidebar (desktop) + mobile drawer, Notify Users buttons POST correct broadcast APIs (200), Notifications panel form+list works and POSTs /api/notifications (200), 30-min localStorage SWR cache writes fh_cache::home:schemes and fh_cache::home:products, Promise.all parallel fetch (schemes/products requests fire with 0ms delta), Mandi 500ms debounce works (filters after typing), #emergent-badge absent at runtime, no horizontal scroll at 390px.

minor.issue: Intermittent 502 when data.gov.in upstream read-timeout (30s). Carry-over from iter 2. Consider adding 1 retry or widening to 45s. Note /api/mandi already uses 45s; /api/mandi/districts and /api/mandi/insights still use 30s. Recommend aligning all upstream timeouts to 45s with 1 retry.

verified_flows: Home: 4 distinct feature containers — home-weather-container (emerald tint), home-mandi-container, home-schemes-container (amber), home-products-container — each with bold Lucide icon + title
Home: data-testid=home-refresh-btn present + 'Last updated: HH:MM:SS AM' timestamp appears after first load
Home: Promise.all parallel fetch verified — schemes & products API requests fire with ~0ms delta (same tick)
Home: 30-min localStorage SWR cache — keys 'fh_cache::home:schemes' and 'fh_cache::home:products' created after first load
TopHeader: NotificationBell with data-testid=notif-bell-btn; unread badge data-testid=notif-unread-badge (shows '6' in badge); clicking opens data-testid=notif-dropdown
Notifications dropdown lists recent notifications (Test broadcast, Hello farmers, New Scheme: ..., TEST_Notif_...) — verified via screenshot
Emergent badge removed: #emergent-badge is absent at runtime (both stripped from index.html and MutationObserver in App.js works)
Admin sidebar visible at desktop (>=md): Control Center / Govt Schemes / Store Products / Notifications / Back to App (all sidebar entries found)
Admin mobile: data-testid=admin-menu-btn opens data-testid=admin-mobile-nav drawer at 390px viewport
Admin: each Scheme row has data-testid=scheme-notify-<id> (6 buttons); clicking POST /api/notifications/broadcast-scheme/<id> → 200 + success toast 'Notification sent to all users!'
Admin: each Product row has data-testid=product-notify-<id> (6 buttons); clicking POST /api/notifications/broadcast-product/<id> → 200

Admin Notifications panel: notif-title-input, notif-body-input, notif-link-input, notif-send-btn, notifications-list all present. Sending custom broadcast POSTs /api/notifications → 200, and new item appears in 'Sent updates' list
Mandi search input has 500ms debounce (no crash/thrash while typing) and correctly filters (typing 'tom' → Tomato visible)

Backend Notifications endpoints: create requires auth (401 no token), list is public with newest-first sort, ?since filter correctly excludes, ?limit capped at 200, broadcast-scheme/product 404 on missing id, delete 404 on missing id
action_items: Optional: align /api/mandi/districts and /api/mandi/insights upstream timeout to 45s (currently 30s) + 1 retry — matches /api/mandi and will reduce rare 502 flakes when data.gov.in is slow.
No other fixes required. All Iteration 3 acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/mandi/districts uses 3600s in-memory TTL but problem statement elsewhere referenced '15 min' — consider aligning or documenting the intended SLA.

server.py uses sync `requests` in async FastAPI handlers for 3 mandi/weather endpoints (blocks event loop). Carry-over; low-priority for current traffic but should migrate to httpx.AsyncClient before scaling.
server.py Notification model is clean — UUID id, created_at, indexes on id + created_at created in startup. Good.
Frontend: cache.js persists API results under 'fh_cache::' prefix with 30-min TTL; verified in localStorage. Good.
Frontend: NotificationsContext polls /api/notifications every 30s — acceptable; could be upgraded to Server-Sent Events for lower latency if real-time becomes a requirement.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestNotifications class with 11 new tests covering all 5 new notification endpoints)
seed_data_creation: Test notifications created and auto-cleaned in pytest. A few admin-created TEST_* notifications from Playwright remain in DB (harmless, cleaned via admin panel delete if desired).

rca of the issue: No blockers. Single backend failure (test_mandi_districts_for_state) is an upstream data.gov.in read-timeout (>30s), not a code bug. Mitigation: increase timeout to 45s + 1 retry inside /api/mandi/districts handler (carry-over recommendation from iter 2).
